text:
arjun: quick sync — we need a proposal for per-route/tenant sample budgeting before next week's infra review. head/tail mix + retention targets. thoughts?

mia: we should decouple visibility vs cost. e.g. critical routes get head=100% for first X spans, tail sampled by score. low-priority routes get aggressive head trimming. :thinking:

sam: agree. also need to think exporter bandwidth — OTLP spikes when head window floods. maybe rate-limit per-tenant exporter or batch-size controls.

arjun: +1 on per-tenant exporter quotas. worried about bursty tenants blowing our retention budgets and SLOs.

leah: what about making the head window adaptive from traffic percentiles? if a tenant has 99th p90 latency churn, extend head. otherwise shrink.

mia: adaptive windows sounds nice but can be noisy. propose combining: static route tier (critical/standard/low) + percentile-adaptive multiplier + global budget. simpler to reason about in console.

sam: concrete config sketch:
```
sampler_v2:
  tiers:
    critical: {head_ms: 2000, tail_rate: 0.02}
    standard: {head_ms: 500, tail_rate: 0.005}
    low: {head_ms: 200, tail_rate: 0.001}
  adaptive:
    enabled: true
    p90_multiplier: 1.5
  global_budget_per_min_per_tenant: 5000
```

arjun: that helps. we also need earmarks for security-sensitive tenants (retention longer, no external exporters). add flags for private-retain and disable-export.

leah: UX note — console needs to surface "budget burn" per tenant and per route. a single card with sparkline + forecast to next billing period. customers have to be able to request temporary burn increases.

mia: +1. also expose expected cost delta when changing tail_rate in the UI. engineers should be able to preview token/span cost impact before rolling a policy. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

sam: on implementation: prefer doing sampling at ingest (edge) vs collector. edge reduces wasted IO but is harder to update rollout. collector-based sampling lets us A/B different samplers more easily. thoughts?

arjun: prefer edge for cost reasons, but we need a safe rollout plan: feature flag + canary tenants + centralized policy push. fallback to collector if policy mismatch.

leah: can we support a hybrid? edge does primary sampling, collector runs a secondary probabilistic tail sampler for routes marked experimental so we can evaluate without full cost.

mia: that would let us run A/B on tail quality. good idea.

ops-bot: deploy: sampler-config-service v2 -> canary (10 tenants) at 1963456830 (automated)

sam: FYI, add metric "sampler.drop_rate_by_tenant" and an alert when > 0.95 for >5m. some tenants were fully dropped last quarter due to misconfig.

arjun: also log sampled-out-span reasons (quota, tail-prob, head-expired) -- minimal payload to avoid cost.

leah: last thing — retention tiers. we should offer 3 tiers in product: 7d, 30d, 90d. backend maps retention to per-tenant budget multipliers. customers can request exceptions.
mia: ok i'll draft a short PR outlining config schema + console mocks + rollout plan and share by EOD.
arjun: thanks — ping me when PR is up, I'll attach cost model and test queries.

(reacted with :thumbsup: by arjun and sam)
